prompt: Create ONE new 3:2 landscape illustration for a Catalan school listening worksheet. Inputs are character identity and style REFERENCES only, not edit targets. Soft watercolor and colored-pencil storybook drawing on warm ivory paper, muted sage and earth tones, natural relaxed expressions, one single coherent scene. Match the reference characters precisely. Not a character sheet. No readable text, labels, numbers, logos, border, or watermark. Do not visually reveal answers to comprehension questions. Mar, adult woman with dark low ponytail, olive blazer and cream shirt, records with her microphone in a neutral rehearsal-room doorway. A closed cello case and a stack of folded music stands sit nearby, suggesting concert preparations. Intimate medium-wide composition, warm indoor light, no other people. This must not identify a school hall or civic center. No rain, umbrellas, weather symbols, clock, seats for an audience, measurements, seating plans, posters or text. Do not show tests of stage capacity or concert location decisions.
alt: La Mar prepara una notícia en una estança amb estoig d’instrument i faristols desats.
notes: Il·lustració contextual pròpia; els models fixen la identitat dels recurrents. Revisió independent abans de publicar. Conversió a WebP, sense retoc del contingut.
